# KKday

> > KKday is a travel experiences and local activities booking platform specializing in Asian destinations, with a focus on Philippines tourism and Taiwanese specialty food delivery.

KKday connects travelers with authentic local experiences across popular Asian destinations including Cebu, Boracay, Palawan, and Manila, while also offering curated Taiwanese delicacies like Sunnyhills pineapple cakes and traditional snacks for home delivery.

## Key Topics

- Philippines travel destinations
- Island hopping tours
- Whale shark watching in Oslob
- Cebu and Bohol attractions
- Boracay beach activities
- Universal Studios Singapore
- Taiwanese pineapple cakes
- Sunnyhills specialty foods
- Local tour experiences
- Beach destination guides
- Traditional Taiwanese snacks
- Gift boxes and pastries
- Metro Manila activities
- Tourism booking platform
- Asian travel experiences

## Philippines Travel Experiences

- [Things To Do In Phillippines For Locals](https://www.act.kkday.com/things-to-do-locally/philippines/): Philippines travel guide featuring Cebu, Boracay, Palawan & Metro Manila

## Taiwanese Food & Specialty Products

- [Enjoy Taiwanese delicacies in the comfort of your home](https://www.act.kkday.com/): Taiwanese food delivery featuring Sunnyhills pineapple cakes & snacks
